prompt:
A cinematic storyboard sheet for a Sri Lankan television drama: 9 photorealistic film stills of ONE scene, laid out in a grid 3 panels across and 3 down, read left to right, then top to bottom. Every panel is a tall portrait 9:16 still of the same size, separated by thin, even, plain white gutters. All panels are the same moment's world, painted together: the same people, props, weather, light and colour grade in every panel.

Reference images, in order: image 1 is the location plate for Colombo roadside; image 2 is the reference sheet for phone. Take from image 1: the kind of place: its ground, water, plants, structures and materials. It is ONE view of the place; each panel has its own camera position, so do not repeat this view in every panel; image 2: phone exactly as shown.

People (every panel): every person is a smooth, matte, faceless artist's mannequin in one solid colour, with jointed limbs and simple hands: Kasun is the red mannequin; Anudi is the blue mannequin. A small raised ridge on the front of the head, where a nose would be, shows which way the head faces. Each mannequin has the person's real height and build and sits, stands and holds things exactly as a real person would. No faces, no hair, no clothes, no skin: only the mannequin colour. Everything else (the place, the props, the light, the weather) is a real, photorealistic film still.

World (every panel): One painted storyboard image, four columns by three rows, read left to right and then downward: eleven panels with narrow gutters and an empty bottom-right cell. No lettering, numbers, captions or arrows appear anywhere. The surroundings and props are realistic. Soft overcast morning daylight, approximately 5600K, falls from the open road at camera right onto rain-wet concrete and patched asphalt, with muted greys, earth tones and controlled reflections. A small amber shop practical glows beneath an awning. Anudi's open navy umbrella remains in her left hand, with her structured tan handbag hanging from her left shoulder. Her orange smartphone has a transparent cover and the reference's triple-camera arrangement. The modest grey-green food three-wheeler has a dark canopy, a metal serving counter and covered food trays.

Geography: The road occupies the foreground, with the open kerb drain and narrow pavement running horizontally across the image. The food-business zone is screen left, backed by shuttered commercial frontage and a modest concrete building; the conversation takes place immediately to its right. Kasun stands left of Anudi, with the three-wheeler behind and to his left. A stained pale boundary wall stands behind Anudi and continues along the departure pavement toward screen right, ending near a utility pole visible in the widest frame. All cameras remain roadward of the Kasun–Anudi axis. Close views retain the canopy toward frame left or the pale wall toward frame right. The eventual paths run right along the wall for Anudi and left toward the serving counter for Kasun; the opening frames remain at the conversation spot.

PANEL 1 (row 1, column 1) — Roadward master position, looking across the drain toward the pavement; standing head height, 50mm feel, waist-up two-shot with both sets of hands visible. Background: The three-wheeler canopy and counter are softly resolved at frame left behind Kasun; the stained pale wall occupies frame right behind Anudi. The red Kasun mannequin stands screen left, chest facing right and head turned three-quarter right toward the blue Anudi mannequin, with his right hand extending the orange handset between them and his empty left hand lowered. Anudi stands screen right, chest facing left and head turned three-quarter left toward him, her open right palm directly beneath the offered handset. Her left hand grips the umbrella shaft near her shoulder, the tan handbag hangs at her left hip, and the handset's display is angled out of view.
PANEL 2 (row 1, column 2) — Farther back on the roadward side, looking across the pavement; standing head height, 35mm feel, medium-wide framing to mid-thigh. Background: The three-wheeler and its covered trays are clearly visible at frame left, with shuttered frontage behind; the pale wall and continuing pavement occupy frame right. Kasun stands left with his chest facing right, head turned three-quarter right toward Anudi, and both empty hands lowered. Anudi stands right with her chest facing left, her head angled toward the business beyond Kasun, and the smartphone held low in her right hand with its display turned inward. Her left hand holds the open umbrella shaft, and the handbag hangs against her left hip.
PANEL 3 (row 1, column 3) — Same roadward position and height as shot 1; 50mm feel, waist-up two-shot. Background: The dark canopy remains softly visible at frame left behind Kasun; the stained pale wall remains frame right behind Anudi. Kasun stands screen left with his chest facing right, head turned three-quarter right toward Anudi, and both empty hands resting beside his body. Anudi stands screen right with her chest and head directed three-quarter left toward him, holding the phone horizontally low at her waist in her right hand. Her left hand stays around the umbrella shaft, with the tan handbag suspended from her left shoulder.
PANEL 4 (row 2, column 1) — Roadward side, slightly toward Anudi's end of the axis, looking obliquely toward Kasun; standing head height, approximately 1.55 metres, 75mm feel, chest-up medium close-up. Background: Soft dark canopy occupies frame left behind Kasun; a narrow blurred strip of pale masonry sits at frame right. Kasun fills the left and centre of the panel, leaving space to screen right. His chest faces right toward Anudi beyond the crop, his head turns three-quarter right in the same direction, and both empty hands remain lowered below the bottom edge. His torso is upright and his chin is level.
PANEL 5 (row 2, column 2) — Roadward side near Anudi, looking obliquely toward the wall; standing head height, approximately 1.55 metres, 50mm feel, waist-up medium shot. Background: The pale stained wall fills frame right; a softly blurred green edge of the vending bay appears at far left. Anudi stands right of centre with her chest facing left and her head turned three-quarter left toward Kasun beyond the crop. Her right hand holds the phone at her right hip, orange back visible and display concealed, while her left hand grips the umbrella shaft near shoulder height. The handbag rests at her left hip, and the umbrella canopy is cropped by the upper edge.
PANEL 6 (row 2, column 3) — Close to the roadward position used for shot 5, approximately 1.25 metres high and angled slightly downward; normal close-focus lens, tight insert. Background: Wet pavement forms the lower-left blur and the pale wall forms the upper-right blur, retaining the previous setup's orientation. Anudi's blue right hand and the orange handset fill the panel, with her fingers wrapped around its edges and her thumb resting along the near side. The transparent cover and three rear camera circles are clearly rendered, while the display faces away from the camera. Only her hand and a short section of forearm enter the crop.
PANEL 7 (row 3, column 1) — Roadward of Anudi, slightly toward Kasun's end of the axis; approximately 1.7 metres high with a slight downward oblique angle, 50mm feel, chest-up medium close-up with deep focus. Background: The pale wall remains on frame right, with a narrow soft green frontage edge at far left. Anudi's chest faces left and her head bends three-quarter down-left toward the upright phone in her right hand just below her head. The display tilts upward toward her and partly toward the camera, showing a simple incoming-call arrangement of unlabelled shapes without a portrait or lettering. Her left hand remains on the umbrella shaft near her shoulder, with the handbag strap visible over that shoulder.
PANEL 8 (row 3, column 2) — Roadward side, at Anudi's standing head height of approximately 1.55 metres; 85mm feel, tight three-quarter close-up. Background: Soft pale wall occupies frame right, with a thin darker green blur at the far-left edge. Anudi's head and the handset fill most of the panel, her head turned three-quarter left rather than square to the camera. Her chest continues to face left, and her bent right arm brings the phone against the right side of her head, its orange edge visible along the far contour. Her left hand holds the umbrella shaft below the crop, with a short section of shaft entering along the panel edge.
PANEL 9 (row 3, column 3) — Same roadward position and standing height as shots 1 and 3; 50mm feel, waist-up two-shot. Background: The softly resolved three-wheeler canopy remains frame left behind Kasun; the stained pale wall remains frame right behind Anudi. Kasun stands screen left with his chest facing right, head turned three-quarter right toward Anudi, and both empty hands lowered. Anudi stands screen right with her chest facing left and the phone held against the right side of her head by her raised right hand. Her head remains angled three-quarter left, while her left hand holds the umbrella shaft and the handbag stays at her left hip.

Bodies (every panel): each person sits or stands the way a real person does the task in front of them, never posed for the camera. The body faces the task and only the head turns: someone at a steering wheel sits squarely behind it, the wheel centred in front of the chest, back against the seat, both hands on the rim; someone at a desk sits square to it; someone at a stove faces the stove. A camera beside a person sees the body side-on, not the chest. Nobody looks into or faces the lens unless the panel says so. Head and eyes turn together: the eyes never roll hard to one side while the face points at the camera; a near-frontal face looks just past the lens.

Draw NO text of any kind: no panel numbers, no captions, no titles, no timestamps, no arrows, no labels, no borders other than the gutters. The people, place and everyday details are Sri Lankan.
